question: How do finite-library acute D6 inflamed/control relative RNA differences compare with recovered-baseline D30 history/control differences across the source-qualified common gene universe?
decision: Describe continuous effect profiles, finite-library spread and normalization/expression-qualification sensitivity, then propose a justified bounded S3 or S4 comparison for parent review without treating S2 completion as biological resolution.
strongest_rival: Cross-time platform/layout and cell-composition differences, sparse pooled preparations and relative-normalization assumptions can alter apparent attenuation or persistence without establishing intrinsic memory or isolated recovery.
discriminator: Separate within-time four-library normalization and contrasts; report every library, low/zero flags, all-four-library contrast ranges, a total-count sensitivity and unselected union/both-time qualified universes. These checks assess measurement stability but cannot resolve animal overlap, composition or absolute RNA abundance.
exposure_record: Published results, selected loci and D6 profiles were previously viewed; interrupted source turns and S1M inspected metadata and count structure. No S2 effects were calculated before this contract freeze. Synthetic pipeline tests used artificial identifiers/counts only and exposed a floating-point zero-sign issue, documented and fixed prospectively with a computational tie tolerance. Annotation acquisition is a public-source byte retrieval, not gene-effect selection.
biological_unit: Two deposited RNA libraries per history/time group for finite-library description; the paper reports duplicate pooled preparations, while exact animal membership/overlap and cross-assay or cross-time pairing remain unverified.
nesting_and_overlap: Libraries may represent author-reported pooled preparations; genes and reads are features/nested measurements, never independent biological replicates. No individual IDs, matched pairs, longitudinal trajectories or added pool replicates are invented.
population_and_selection: Exactly GSM2440985-2440988 at D6 and GSM2440989-GSM2440992 at D30; retain all 47729 exact versioned gene IDs and all eight libraries. Annotation matches exact GENCODE M9 IDs only and does not select analysis genes.
contrast: D6 acute inflamed GSM2440987/2440988 minus controls GSM2440985/2440986; separately D30 recovered-baseline history GSM2440991/2440992 minus controls GSM2440989/2440990. Compare profiles descriptively across times with platform/layout qualifications.
endpoint: Per-library relative normalized RNA gene counts; log2 ratios of arithmetic exposed/control group means with one reference-count pseudocount; continuous effects, finite-library spread, zero/low-count flags and normalization sensitivity. No population p-values, functional endpoint, equivalence or resolved/persistent class.
methods: Within each timepoint use genes positive in all four libraries for exp(median(log count minus gene mean-log reference)); center factors to geometric mean one. Total-count/geometric-mean-total scaling is the sole normalization sensitivity; also output CPM. Compute log2((mean_exposed+1)/(mean_control+1)), unregularized ratios when defined, all four unpaired cross-library log-ratio ranges, and group log ranges. CPM>=1 in >=2/4 libraries qualifies a timepoint; primary displays use the union across times, with both-time and full-universe summaries. Continuous values remain unrounded; 1e-10 computational ties govern sign/boundary flags. Use three PNG/PDF figures and six prespecified unique extreme/sensitivity/spread examples, with selection/regression-to-mean limits. A separately implemented standard-library verifier recomputes all normalized values, contrasts, flags and joins.
missingness_and_exclusions: No source gene/library is dropped from complete outputs. Low counts, individual/group/all zeros and regularization sensitivity are flagged. Undefined unregularized effects are NA. Exact-version annotation misses remain labeled by original ID. No outcome-based sample exclusion, hidden imputation or assumed biological pairing.
multiplicity: Not applicable: no hypothesis tests or population p-values. Selected display examples are descriptive extremes, not discoveries or evidence for aggregate attenuation.
precision_basis: Finite-library values/ranges are reported without population uncertainty, gene-as-replicate intervals, power or a biological effect margin. The 1e-10 tolerances are computational only.
interpretation_limit: Relative count normalization does not measure absolute RNA abundance. Cross-time differences remain potentially platform/layout/composition dependent and are not isolated recovery trajectories. Small or zero D30 effects, particularly low/all-zero genes, do not establish equivalence or resolution. Source-reported duplicate pooling is preserved without asserting unknown exact membership; a separate inferential reproduction remains possible if justified.
stop_rule: Require committed frozen contract/code and matching input hashes; fail on nonunique source joins, unexpected sample identity, gene/order/structure mismatch, empty positive-reference set, nonfinite normalization, or failed independent checks. Preserve any failed run and amend with a new version. Stop after completed S2 verification and parent handoff. If this bounded task is explicitly rejected, do not retry through another executor or repackage blocked source extraction.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective S2 finite-library RNA description after coordinator-reviewed S1M; all prior exposure and restriction/refusal history retained.
